title: Avoid unrelated creature metaphors
context: Any writing — GPT-5.4 Thinking · historical Nerdy personality
rule: Do not introduce goblins or other creature metaphors into unrelated prose.
example: The build failed because a dependency is missing.
counterexample: A dependency goblin sabotaged the build.
rationale: The metaphor distracts from the actual cause.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/ne-fac/_template/models/openai/available/gpt-5.4.md`. Examples are illustrative.
